steps.title: Initialize ZenHabit project files
steps.description: Configure the core structure of the ZenHabit application, setting up package pathways and directories.

steps.title: Configure build environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, SDK 34, and compile configurations for Java 1.8.

steps.title: Generate Android Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml with proper activity registration, launchers, and standard Material Light theme specifications.

steps.title: Build Button custom drawables
steps.description: Produce modern rounded-corner teal visual components for modernizing all interactive touch targets.

steps.title: Build Card background drawables
steps.description: Produce fine solid backgrounds with light borders to build card structures inside dynamic lists.

steps.title: Construct Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Write activity_main.xml layout structure featuring native tabs, habit tracker scrolls, pomodoro custom components, and mood entries.

steps.title: Create Habit data representation
steps.description: Build Habit.java helper class to map titles, active streaks, goals, and categories safely in system memory.

steps.title: Implement Custom Canvas Timer visualizer
steps.description: Build CustomTimerVisualizerView.java running custom scaling rings that emulate smooth human deep breathing animations.

steps.title: Implement Native Canvas Chart renderer
steps.description: Construct CustomChartView.java plotting continuous multi-point mood values over 7 days onto custom canvas margins.

steps.title: Program MainActivity controller logic
steps.description: Write core interactive logic mapping tabs, loading SharedPreferences data, and responding to state modifications.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 target compilation
steps.description: Scan files to ensure no multi-line lambdas or target API incompatibility is present, preserving compile environment integrity.

steps.title: Building ZenHabit
steps.description: Finalize assembly processes compiling production layout, custom rendering components, and storage pipelines.
